messages:
Maya (Finance): FYI - just saw ACME Health invoice 8247 failed on renewal, card declined by acquirer with weird AVS/3DS response. Customer emailed upset.
Sam (Payments): Can you paste the processor decline code?
Maya (Finance): "status=declined; code=92; reason=issuer_referred; cvv=match; avs=partial" - coming from gateway metadata.
Eli (Support): Customer said they updated card last week. They tried a manual retry in UI and got same decline.
Sam (Payments): Code 92 usually means 'call issuer' / non-automatable. But gateway also flagged 3DS challenge not completed. Do we have 3ds logs?
payments-bot: Webhook 204 received at 2026-03-15T14:02:13Z for payment.intent.8247: event=payment_failed, decline_code=92, acquirer_msg=refer_to_issuer
Sam (Payments): Looking at gateway: acquirer returned 'refer_to_issuer' and acquirer_requires_manual_action=true. Gateway tried fallback route but both acquirers returned same.
Nora (Accounting): We need a short-term plan: customer will churn if we block access. Options: issue a one-time invoice grace + manual collect, ask for wire, or apply a temporary credit. Thoughts?
Eli (Support): Customer asked for a charge reversal if we can't collect. They're willing to pay by wire but asked for instructions ASAP.
Maya (Finance): I'd prefer to avoid manual credits. If they can wire we should provide wire instrs and pause auto-retry. Is there KYC/limits for wire for this account?
Nora (Accounting): Account is cleared for wires up to $50k. Invoice is $18,200. Fine. I'll draft wire instructions.
Sam (Payments): Also recommend asking customer to re-add card with full 3DS flow in browser (not mobile in-app) - some issuers block push 3DS. Send this as parallel option.
Eli (Support): I'll message customer: "We can accept a one-time wire or you can try re-adding your card via desktop to complete 3DS. If you choose wire, please let us know and I'll send instructions." Sound OK?
payments-bot: Reminder scheduled: followup-note created for invoice 8247 -> notify finance in 48h if no response.
Maya (Finance): If they confirm wire, Nora - please include beneficiary contact and ACH vs SWIFT instructions. Also add 'urgent' flag so ops marks invoice as paid on receipt.
Nora (Accounting): Draft wire instructions ready: "Bank: First Union Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Acct: 987654321
Routing (ACH/ABA): 123456789
SWIFT: FUBKUS33
Ref: invoice 8247 - customer name" - will send after I get approval on small wording + internal reference code.
Sam (Payments): Approve sending wire details. Also, can we capture payment metadata to link wire to the invoice? Add the invoice ref in payment note and ask customer to include the internal ref.
Eli (Support): Sending to customer now. Message: "Hey - sorry about the decline. Two options: 1) re-add card on desktop to complete 3DS and we'll try once, 2) pay by wire - reply 'WIRE' and we'll send instructions. If we don't hear back in 48h we'll pause the subscription to avoid more failed attempts."
payments-bot: Reminder scheduled: followup-note created for invoice 8247 -> notify finance in 48h if no response.
Maya (Finance): If they confirm wire, Nora - send instructions now and copy me. I'll block further auto-retries for this invoice.
Nora (Accounting): Sent wire instructions to customer + requested proof of transfer (bank confirmation). Email subject: "Redwood Inference - Wire instructions for invoice 8247"
Eli (Support): Customer acknowledged, said treasury will initiate today and send confirmation once done.
Sam (Payments): Once we get proof, I'll mark invoice paid in ledger and stop gateway retries. Also add a note so billing doesn't auto-refund.
Maya (Finance): Thanks everyone. Postmortem: we should add a small KB for customers about 3DS desktop requirement and a sticky to check acquirer routing when decline_code=92. I'll create action items later.
Eli (Support): Noted. Closing loop after payment clears. :white_check_mark:
